request.style: English, male deep voice, solo with choir, acoustic guitar, upright bass, organ, brushed drums, solemn and reflective, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Return from the exile with Zerubbabel
Priests and Levites stood in the gate
Names of the leaders in the days of Jeshua
Mijamin and Maadiah are named

[Pre-Chorus]
Shemaiah and Joiarib are here
Jedaiah and Sallu stand near
Amok and Hilkiah keep faith
These were the heads in the days of Jeshua

[Chorus]
Sealing the covenant with the Lord
The law of God in the heart
Bilgah's family serves the house
Faithful through the generations

[Verse]
In the days of the high priest Joiakim
Shammua was the head of the line
Of Bilgah the family continued
Serving in the temple of God

[Chorus]
Sealing the covenant with the Lord
The law of God in the heart
Bilgah's family serves the house
Faithful through the generations

[Bridge]
Fifteenth division in David's time
The order of service remains
Meshullam and Abijah sign
Mijamin seals the written word

[Chorus]
Sealing the covenant with the Lord
The law of God in the heart
Bilgah's family serves the house
Faithful through the generations

[Outro]
Bilgah and Bilga stand together
Sealed in the covenant of God
